data.name: Animal Husbandry
data.detailed_description:
Step into a world of unsettling charm on Honeydough Isle, a hidden biological preserve shrouded in perpetual fog. By day, enjoy a tranquil life in a vibrant, surreal field where you can bond with local animal-human hybrids and find comfort in the beauty of your surroundings. When you aren’t socializing, take charge of the local bakery to craft delicious pastries and serve the island's unique residents.

But as the sun sets, the "cozy" facade begins to fracture. Armed with only your wits and what you can scavenge, you must navigate the island’s dark underbelly at night to uncover the truth behind the mysterious "Ambrosia" and find a way to escape before the upcoming Harvest Festival.

Key Features:

Charming Social Simulation: Spend your mornings and evenings befriending a cast of hybrid characters in a seemingly peaceful paradise.

Bakery Management: Run the island’s bakery, creating treats for customers while navigating the strange social dynamics of the town.

Nighttime Survival Horror: Explore restricted areas under the cover of darkness, solving puzzles and avoiding detection to reveal the island's grim secrets.

Unravel the Mystery: Discover journals and hidden documents to piece together the history of the island and the dark purpose of your visit.

But as night falls, the cozy atmosphere shifts into a chilling survival horror experience. Explore a mysterious island, solve puzzles, and find your way out before the sun rises.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Six-core Intel or AMD, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
